plan.title: 名偵探柯南 (Detective Conan)
plan.summary: A tactical support/control hero who uses 'deduction' to mark targets, 'gadgets' to manipulate the battlefield, and 'truth' to reveal hidden threats. He excels at area denial and debuffing enemies through information gathering.

champion.name: 名偵探柯南
champion.description: A master of deduction who uses gadgets to control the flow of battle. He marks enemies with 'Truth' and uses 'Tranquilizers' to slow their movements.

abilities.name: 推理能力 (Deduction)
abilities.description: Attacking an enemy marks them for 10 seconds. Marked enemies have their hidden status revealed.

abilities.name: 麻醉槍 (Tranquilizer Gun)
abilities.description: Fires a tranquilizer bolt that slows the target by 40% for 2.5 seconds and pulls them slightly toward the caster.

abilities.name: 變聲器 (Voice Changer)
abilities.description: Emits a confusing frequency. Taunts nearby enemies for 2 seconds and has a 30% chance to cause Confusion.

abilities.name: 足球傳送 (Soccer Ball Trick)
abilities.description: Kicks a soccer ball that knocks back and pulls enemies in a radial area.

abilities.name: 真相大白 (The Truth)
abilities.description: Ultimate: Reveals the truth of the battlefield. Creates a massive zone that blinds and heavily slows all enemies for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: 名偵探的直覺 (Detective's Intuition)
abilities.description: Instantly blink a short distance to dodge incoming danger.
